    • Method Detail

      • withLanguage

        @NonNull
CreateDseFunctionWithLanguage withLanguage​(@NonNull
                                           String language)
        Adds LANGUAGE to the create function specification. This is used to specify what language is used in the function body.

      • withJavaLanguage

        @NonNull
default CreateDseFunctionWithLanguage withJavaLanguage()
        Adds "LANGUAGE java" to create function specification. Shortcut for withLanguage("java").

      • withJavaScriptLanguage

        @NonNull
default CreateDseFunctionWithLanguage withJavaScriptLanguage()
        Adds "LANGUAGE javascript" to create function specification. Shortcut for withLanguage("javascript").

      • deterministic

        @NonNull
CreateDseFunctionWithType deterministic()
        Adds "DETERMINISTIC" to create function specification. This is used to specify that this function always returns the same output for a given input.

      • monotonic

        @NonNull
CreateDseFunctionWithType monotonic()
        Adds "MONOTONIC" to create function specification. This is used to specify that this function is either entirely non-increasing, or entirely non-decreasing.

      • monotonicOn

        @NonNull
CreateDseFunctionWithType monotonicOn​(@NonNull
                                      com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlIdentifier monotonicColumn)
        Adds "MONOTONIC ON" to create function specification. This is used to specify that this function has only a single column that is monotonic. If the function is fully monotonic, use monotonic() instead.

      • monotonicOn

        @NonNull
default CreateDseFunctionWithType monotonicOn​(@NonNull
                                              String monotonicColumn)
        Shortcut for monotonicOn(CqlIdentifier.fromCql(monotonicColumn)).
